preconditions.description: The input must be a list containing exactly three rounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round, list) and len(round) == 2 for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round must be a list containing exactly two elements: a dictionary and a boolean.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[0], dict) and 'P1' in round[0] and 'P2' in round[0] for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round's first element must be a dictionary with keys 'P1' and 'P2'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[1], bool) for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round's second element must be a boolean indicating the hit value.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the three specified strings indicating the winner or a draw.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Pete Wins!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) > sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: If Pete's total score is greater than Phil's, the output must be 'Pete Wins!'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Phil Wins!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) > sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: If Phil's total score is greater than Pete's, the output must be 'Phil Wins!'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Draw!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) == sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: If both scores are equal, the output must be 'Draw!'.
